$comment: Per-skill content for the website: what each skill checks, and a real output shown as evidence. Images live in site/assets/evidence/ and are produced by running the skill on its bundled example.

motion-video.summary: Turns a brief into a storyboard, an HTML composition and a frame-accurate MP4, GIF, WebM or transparent MOV.
checks: Renders a filmstrip contact sheet and reviews it before the final render
Lints every frame for off-safe-area text, tiny type, unloaded fonts and cut-off animation
Encodes with Playwright and ffmpeg at the exact frame count, color-tagged for browsers and players

evidence.caption: Knack's launch film: composed from real skill output and rendered by the skill. Source in examples/knack-promo.

demo-recorder.summary: Scripts a flow through your running app and records a crisp clip with a smooth cursor, zoom and captions.
checks: Dry-runs the flow and screenshots every step before recording
Suggests working selectors when a step fails
Builds a contact sheet of the encoded clip and warns above GitHub's 10 MB limit

evidence.caption: examples/flow.json recorded against the bundled demo app: 14.8s, 890 KB MP4.

responsive-qa.summary: Sweeps a page from 320px to 1920px and reports layout bugs with the element that causes them.
checks: Finds sideways scroll and names the element pushing it
Flags clipped text, overlapping controls and tap targets under 24px
Re-runs after each fix and compares against the previous report

evidence.caption: sweep.mjs at 1280px: the API endpoint overflows its card (1) and the avatar is squashed (2). Boxes match report.json.

a11y-audit.summary: Runs axe-core and a real keyboard pass, then fixes violations in source until the page passes.
checks: axe-core 4.13 against WCAG 2.2 AA, with selectors and HTML for every node
Tabs through the page for traps, invisible or obscured focus, hover-only menus and unreachable controls
Suggests the nearest passing color for every contrast failure, matching WebAIM's math

evidence.caption: audit.mjs on examples/inaccessible-page.html: 4 critical, 12 serious, 4 moderate. Dashed boxes come from the keyboard pass.

token-drift.summary: Finds colors and spacing that bypass your design tokens, maps each to the right token and fixes the safe ones.
checks: Reads CSS variables, Tailwind v3 and v4, DTCG JSON, SCSS and LESS tokens, per package in monorepos
Matches colors by CIEDE2000 and sizes by distance to the scale
Fixes only exact, rendering-safe replacements and lists anything that changes with the theme

lines: token-drift · examples/acme-dashboard/  8 files · 380 tokens from 4 sources
Drift score   13%  11 of 83 design values use tokens
EXACT       48  equals a token → swap in the token (41 auto-fixable)
NEAR        10  within threshold of a token
evidence.caption: Real output on the bundled example. Values that need judgment (named z-index layers, negative offsets, JS-computed styles) are listed, not changed.

pr-visual-diff.summary: Captures the pages a PR touches on both branches, diffs them and writes the Visual changes section.
checks: Brings up the base branch in a throwaway worktree and never touches yours
Freezes time, animations, video and randomness so unchanged pages diff to 0 pixels
Separates moved, added and removed content from real changes, with close-ups of each region

evidence.caption: focus.png from capture.mjs on examples/before and examples/after: the CTA restyle was intended, the shrunken pricing buttons were not.
